response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(remaining) as overall_average FROM budget WHERE remaining IS NOT NULL), by_status AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining FROM budget WHERE remaining IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status) SELECT by_status.event_status, by_status.avg_remaining, by_status.avg_remaining - overall_avg.overall_average as difference FROM by_status CROSS JOIN overall_avg WHERE overall_avg.overall_average IS NOT NULL
